exact_missing_items: FileManager.md still states one canonical open contract: OpenFile { path: PathBuf, line?, range?, target_group? } — but its later addenda already require a second category of opens
Split FileManager's canonical open contract into: workspace path open, identity-native subject open
Reuse the preview subject identity pattern (doc: / artifact:) as the base instead of inventing a separate parallel scheme
project_id is no longer just a nice-to-have lineage field; its omission now clearly blocks deterministic projector partitioning, replay, and per-project artifact/search indexing
Promote project_id, attempt_id, generated/runtime identity routing, and artifact/evidence join fields to first-class owners in the artifact/file/storage docs
Use `subject_id` only when the target is canonical renderable/openable content.
Use `object_kind` + `object_id` for all runtime, governance, conversational, and workflow objects.
Put the classification rule directly in `Contracts_V0.md`.
